rules.statement: A survivor of a joint will may repudiate the will after the death of the first spouse and stand upon legal rights as the surviving member of the community. If the survivor accepts benefits under the will, they are not entitled to act inconsistently with it, but can pass title to a bona fide purchaser.
rules.supporting_quote: "The question is not determined whether the widow did adiate this will or, if. she did, whether the lessee was a bond fide purchaser of the interest of the widow, because 320 it was argued for the defendant that he was entitled at all events to be paid his interest in the share of the surviving widow in the terms granted by the lease."
